newsitem.title: USA: Brown's Famous Footwear Oct sales off.
newsitem.headline: Brown's Famous Footwear Oct sales off.

text.p: Brown Group Inc said Thursday that October same store sales for its Famous Footwear division dropped 1.7 percent.
Total Famous Footwear sales in the month were $48.9 million, up 1.5 percent.
Year-to-date sales for Famous Footwear increased 9.5 percent to $595.6 million and were up 1.1 percent on a same-store basis.

The Naturalizer division sales fell nine percent in October to $9.3 million, while same store sales were down 7.3 percent. Year-to-date, sales for Naturalizer were up one percent to $99.6 percent and increased 2.1 percent on a same store basis.

"Early November same-store sales results for both businesses show substantial gains over last year; with more seasonal fall weather, we are looking forward to continuing strong November and fourth quarter sales for both the Famous Footwear and Naturalizer chains," Harry Rich, executive vice president and chief financial officer, said.

He said October same store sales results at both Famous Footwear and Naturalizer stores were slightly lower than planned. "They reflect lower than anticipated cold weather boot sales due to mild early winter weather patterns and also lower sales of womens dress shoes," Rich said.
Year-to-date, the rise in same store sales for both chains reflect an improving retail climate and the impact of operating improvements in these businesses.
